contract.userJob: Compare two to five options against shared criteria, recognize each option immediately, and understand which tradeoffs change the decision.

layout.wide: Lead with a grounded recommendation when supplied, show a stable option rail with attributed imagery when available, then align shared criteria in one contained matrix.
layout.compact: Keep the option rail horizontally contained, pin the grounded recommendation or first option, and compare one challenger at a time without page-level overflow.

contract.media: Product imagery is optional, attributed, matched through media.subject to the exact option label, and omitted honestly when unavailable.
contract.fallback: Preserve the complete grounded comparison, criteria, uncertainty, and sources.

gaps: The running desktop MCP host predates the installed bundle and must be fully restarted; reopening a window or resuming the same task does not refresh MCP tools.
Fresh desktop acceptance must confirm that six-section comparisons with three product images mount without representation-slot fallback.
quality.nextAction: Fully quit and reopen ChatGPT/Codex, pass the nine-slot pnpm codex:verify-host preflight, rerun the MacBook Air, Neo, and Pro comparison in a brand-new task, and record human acceptance.
